"""Camera queue production scope. Importable without accessing the source repository."""
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
BASE = '56f3e60158aa747ac959dc8c8c17b8bb0dd58331'
CAMERA = 'app/src/main/java/com/sevtinge/hyperceiler/camera/'
FIXED = (
    CAMERA + 'ScreenOffCapture.java',
    CAMERA + 'ScreenOffCaptureService.java',
    'library/libhook/src/main/java/com/sevtinge/hyperceiler/libhook/rules/systemframework/volume/ScreenOffCamera.java',
)
POLICY = 'camera-queue-v1'
def safe_path(name):
    p = PurePosixPath(name)
    return not p.is_absolute() and str(p) == name and '..' not in p.parts and '\\' not in name

def new_camera_java(name, base_names):
    # Existing selector/preview and ALL other existing camera files remain immutable.
    return (safe_path(name) and name not in base_names and name.startswith(CAMERA)
            and name.endswith('.java')
            and not any(word in name[len(CAMERA):].lower() for word in ('selector', 'preview')))

def assess(changed, base_names, source_names):
    changed, base_names, source_names = set(changed), set(base_names), set(source_names)
    base_source = {n for n in base_names if n.startswith(('app/', 'library/'))}
    assert set(FIXED) <= base_source, 'fixed camera entry points missing from baseline'
    added = source_names - base_source
    assert all(new_camera_java(n, base_names) for n in added), ('new source outside camera Java scope', sorted(added))
    assert base_source <= source_names, 'production deletions forbidden'
    mutable = list(FIXED) + sorted(added)
    source_changes = {n for n in changed if n.startswith(('app/', 'library/'))}
    assert source_changes and source_changes <= set(mutable), ('protected production edits', sorted(source_changes - set(mutable)))
    assert all(safe_path(n) and (n in source_changes or (n.startswith('docs/') and n not in base_names)) for n in changed), 'only camera source and NEW docs may change'
    assert source_names == base_source | added
    return mutable, sorted(added)

import os, subprocess, json, hashlib, base64, lzma, re
from pathlib import Path
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
jb = lambda x: (json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n').encode()
C = None
def git(*args, **kw):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], **kw)
raw = lzma.decompress(base64.b64decode(PAYLOAD, validate=True))
bundle = json.loads(raw)
C = bundle['config']; changes = bundle['changes']
assert C['base'] == '56f3e60158aa747ac959dc8c8c17b8bb0dd58331'
assert C['branch'] == 'codex/camera-queue'
assert C['scope_policy'] == POLICY
base_names = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', C['base']).decode().splitlines()
base_source = {n for n in base_names if n.startswith(('app/', 'library/'))}
allowed, added = assess(changes, base_names, base_source | set(C['new_camera_sources']))
assert C['mutable_source'] == allowed and C['new_camera_sources'] == added
assert not C['deleted']
assert sha(json.dumps(changes, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode()) == C['delta_sha256'], 'delta hash'
subprocess.run(['git', 'checkout', '--detach', C['base']], check=True)
assert not git('status', '--porcelain').strip(), 'dirty baseline'
for name, edits in changes.items():
    assert name.startswith(('app/', 'library/', 'docs/')) and '..' not in Path(name).parts
    p = Path(name)
    expected = C['base_hashes'][name]
    assert (sha(p.read_bytes()) if p.exists() else None) == expected, 'exact base hash: '+name
    if edits is None:
        p.unlink()
        continue
    lines = p.read_bytes().decode().splitlines(True) if p.exists() else []
    for i, j, text in reversed(edits):
        assert 0 <= i <= j <= len(lines)
        lines[i:j] = [text] if text else []
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
